997-1445-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
997-1445-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2131-2173-4574-8095--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.
2131-2173-4574-8095--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

1556-2174-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-2174-2645-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

856-2173-3899-5220.manaNeeded: {B} if Cauldron Familiar is in your hand
856-2173-3899-5220.easyPrerequisites: You have a life total of at least 2 if Cauldron Familiar is on top of your library.
856-2173-3899-5220.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {B} or 1 life respectively.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2034-5003-6543.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Garrison Cat, adding {C}{C}.
When Garrison Cat dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Garrison Cat trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Garrison Cat from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

6495-6872--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
6495-6872--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a persist creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Long Feng trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other persist creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6872--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

719-2837-7827.description:
Cast Thorin by paying {3}{R}{W}.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters as a Dwarf due to Xenograft, Thorin triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3259-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
1251-3259-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
1251-3259-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

3240-6351-6462-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Teval triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

57-4235-4742-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4742-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2281-5231-5987.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Angel of Indemnity
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity
When Angel of Indemnity dies, Saffi triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-4288-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4288-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Sarinth Greatwurm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Sarinth Greatwurm triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4289-4311-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

654-5234-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-5234-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-5234-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

934-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

6085-6086-6087-6331.easyPrerequisites:
Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
Lure attached to Sentinel.
6085-6086-6087-6331.notablePrerequisites: Sentinel does not have summoning sickness.
6085-6086-6087-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Altanak to an opponent.
Declare Sentinel as an attacker, forcing Altanak to block it due to Lure.
Holding priority, activate Sentinel an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

372-3378-4823.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-4823.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3000-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3000-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood artifact token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

877-4254-4484-5256.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
877-4254-4484-5256.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ebondeath, causing target player to mill cards equal to Ebondeathi's power.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

112-392-4280-5195.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}.
Storm-Kiln Artist, Veyran and Birgi trigger twice each.
Resolve both Birgi triggers, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve both Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve Clockspinning, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

141-554-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-2034.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

293-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Narcomoeba.
Narcomoeba dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill Narcomoeba from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

648-675.notablePrerequisites: Your library size is greater than or equal to an opponent's life total.
648-675.description:
Cast Body of Reaserch by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to your library size.
Cast Grab the Reins by paying {3}{R} and sacrificing the Fractal, dealing damage equal to the Fractal's power to an opponent.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

1015-2194-4860.manaNeeded: {4}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}{R/P}, plus an additional {B} if Scion of the Ur-Dragon has summoning sickness
1015-2194-4860.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Scion of the Ur-Dragon.
1015-2194-4860.description:
Activate Scion of the Ur-Dragon by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Scion of the Ur-Dragon a second time by paying {2}.
Resolve the first Scion of the Ur-Dragon ability, searching your library for Moltensteel Dragon, putting it into your graveyard, causing Scion of the Ur-Dragon to become a copy of Moltensteel Dragon until end of turn, and shuffling your library.
Activate Scion of the Ur-Dragon by paying {R/P}, giving itself +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 4 five additional times.
Resolve the Scion of the Ur-Dragon ability from step 1, searching your library for Skithiryx, putting it into your graveyard, causing Scion of the Ur-Dragon to become a copy of Skithiryx until end of turn, and shuffling your library.
If Scion of the Ur-Dragon has summoning sickness, activate it by paying {B}, giving it haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Scion of the Ur-Dragon, causing an opponent to get ten poison counters and lose the game due to lethal infect damage.

1595-1903-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another artifact creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1595-1903-3259.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Sharding Sphinx.
Resolve the Sharding Sphinx trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Thopter token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1987-2510-3227-3573.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2510-3227-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

45-1987-2427-3277.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
